user_goal: Publish the already reviewed PLOTKEEPER candidate to EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER, then independently attest the public result without requiring post-push evidence before the first push.

baseline.protection_evidence: Clean candidate with 22 passing tests and independent substantive review; publication was blocked only by the prior contract's circular phase model.
baseline.selection_reason: This is the completed integration candidate explicitly authorized for a phase-split publication correction.

semantic_changes: Record this append-only phase correction and checkpoint.
Configure origin and publish the exact independently reviewed candidate to the empty public repository.
Set accurate repository description and topics.
After publication, independently attest the public SHA, files, metadata, visibility, and Actions status before closeout.
Do not change the reviewed product or integration candidate.
Do not publish a SHA other than the corrected-contract candidate reviewed for DEPLOY_READY.
Do not auto-trust hooks, alter local Codex configuration, publish secrets, or weaken rollback controls.
Do not claim completion without post-push independent attestation.

invariants: The reviewed Plotkeeper code, tests, license, attribution, installer, and hook behavior remain byte-for-byte unchanged from 0d41e0742a24a4e07a8f2611733de0f95247fc7e.
Only this contract and checkpoint metadata may change before release review.
The authenticated target remains the empty public EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER repository.
The pushed main SHA must equal the exact DEPLOY_READY candidate SHA.
A failed release is rolled back with the documented force-with-lease procedure.
Post-push evidence is collected only after push and is mandatory for ATTESTED and completion.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The exact unchanged integration candidate plus this phase correction is authorized for an initial push to the authenticated empty repository.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: No different SHA, dirty state, forbidden file change, or unexpected remote baseline may be pushed.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: Primary release agent publishing local main to EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER.

proof_requirements.claim: The protected candidate remains unchanged except for the append-only contract and checkpoint metadata.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Compare 0d41e0742a24a4e07a8f2611733de0f95247fc7e to the release candidate and inspect every changed path.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Only allowed contract and checkpoint paths differ; all 22 tests remain green.

proof_requirements.claim: The authenticated GitHub target is public, empty, and controlled by EmergentKnowledgeGroup immediately before push.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Query auth identity, repository visibility, refs, branches, and default branch.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Authenticated owner is EmergentKnowledgeGroup and the public PLOTKEEPER repository has no pre-existing commit to absorb.

proof_requirements.claim: A precise rollback path exists before publication.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Inspect docs/RELEASE.md and validate its protected SHA and force-with-lease command.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Rollback preserves audit history and lease-binds restoration to the protected baseline.

release_requirements.required_receipt: Exact candidate SHA, clean scope, authenticated empty target, passing tests, and rollback command.

stop_conditions: Any reviewed product or integration file changes after 0d41e0742a24a4e07a8f2611733de0f95247fc7e.
The checkout becomes dirty or contains another worktree.
The GitHub target gains an unexpected ref or changes owner/visibility before push.
Independent DEPLOY_READY review is not PASS for the exact release candidate.
Push, metadata update, Actions, or public attestation fails or contradicts the candidate.
known_discrepancies: The predecessor contract required post-push PR-6 and RL-2 evidence during pre-push validation, creating an impossible circular gate.
The user explicitly authorized an append-only phase split; this contract governs pre-push authorization while post-push evidence remains mandatory for an independent ATTESTED receipt and closeout.
